10.text: The Maritime Chukchee have races with dogs, or, in summer, with skin

12.text: of reindeer-breeders. Chukchee dogs, as I have already mentioned, are of

13.text: inferior quality. Paddling in skin boats is rather too irregular to allow a

14.text: spirited contest for any long distance. The Russianized natives frequently

15.text: arrange private dog-races, with a bet to be paid to the victor. In these races

16.text: the contestants are allowed to use any means, fair or unfair, even to cutting

17.text: the traces of their adversaries. The excitement approaches that in reindeer-races.

18.text: Foot-races and wrestling usually take place at the reindeer-race meets.

19.text: The foot-race follows the reindeer contest, over the same track through the

20.text: snow loosened by the hoofs of the deer. The race is always for a long distance,

21.text: and often covers several miles. The participants remove their outer clothes,

22.text: or else they take off their underclothes and wear the outer trousers and short

23.text: boots without stockings. They carry staffs or sticks, which they rest on the

24.text: ground to assist them in taking long steady strides.
